planning.title: AI 기획: 기준부터 정하기
planning.prompt: Create a polished landscape 3:2 Korean editorial educational infographic for student game developers. White background, navy #14243b, cobalt #2455cb, pale blue with restrained amber. Three spacious illustrated stages left-to-right connected with arrows. Clear large Korean typography integrated into the image, exceptionally legible at 600px width, not tiny text. Exact title at top: "AI 기획: 기준부터 정하기". Exactly these three stage labels, one per stage, left-to-right: "목표 경험", "규칙 비교", "플레이 확인". Illustrations: notebook and compass, two game rule cards, person with gamepad. No other text, no numbers, no logos, no quantitative charts, no fake product screenshots. This is a conceptual explanatory illustration, never proof of a real product or tested outcome. Careful accurate Hangul lettering and balanced spacing.
